title: Nico's day (crime-game parody)
concept: A crime-game style sequence: night city, the phone buzzes, the skyling's heads-up becomes a mission (flowers before dinner), money ticks, day cleared. Nico's real LifeFlow day is on the phone.

scenes.title: Night street, game HUD
scenes.why: A stylised code city reads as 'game' and costs nothing. For a photoreal open-world street with people and traffic, this is the scene to hand to MAGI-2 (hybrid) and keep the HUD in code.

estimate.note: only if the owner wants photoreal footage here

scenes.title: The phone buzzes: the real app
scenes.why: 3D phone in code with the real Today screen captured from the current app.

scenes.title: The heads-up becomes a mission
scenes.why: Mission card, objective line and cash counter are HUD graphics: code does them crisply and repeatably.
